description.value: The Eatery has been Kitsilano's home for creative sushi and Japanese fusion since 1983, earning a devoted local following over four decades on West Broadway. Billed as 'The Funkiest Place for Japanese Food,' it combines inventive rolls and Japanese dishes with a lively, music-filled atmosphere. A touring cyclist finishing a ride on the Arbutus Greenway or along the Vancouver waterfront would find it a well-placed stop for a sit-down meal or a takeout order.
